title: New app
description: Pick a repository or another source. We read it through the provider API and suggest a setup for you to confirm. Nothing is cloned or created until you deploy.

noProvider.lead: No git provider is connected, and you don't need one. Paste a repository URL, pick a template or try the sample app.

source.privateRepo: We could not read this repository. If it is private, connect your git provider and pick it from the list.

repos.noMatch: No repository matches "{{query}}". Paste its full URL to use it directly.
repos.partial: Some connected accounts could not be listed. Paste a URL for anything missing.
repos.emptyBody: We can't see any repositories in your connected accounts yet. Refresh the list after granting access, or paste a repository URL above.
repos.failedBody: The provider did not answer. Refresh to try again, check the connection in Settings, or paste a repository URL above.

git.title: Import from Git
git.connectBody: Connect an account to pick from your repositories, or paste a repository URL above.
git.needsAddress: GitHub sign-in needs a public address for this server.
git.noProviderHint: Public repositories deploy without a git provider. Connect one below for private repos and deploy on push.

sample.body: Deploys a small public sample app so you can see a running deploy in seconds.

warnings.nothing_detected: No Dockerfile, compose file or known framework found. Pick the build type under Advanced.
warnings.read_budget: The file read limit was reached, so some findings may be missing.
warnings.tree_truncated: This repository is large and its file listing was cut short.
warnings.monorepo_choose_app: This looks like a monorepo with several apps. Check the app directory below.
warnings.directory_missing: That directory does not exist on this branch. Pick one from the list above or fix the path.
warnings.port_unknown: No listening port was detected. Set the port the app listens on.

build.title: Build and run
build.appHint: Several buildable apps were found. Choose the one to deploy.

env.title: Environment variables
env.none: The repository declares no environment variables.
env.hasDefault: Leave empty to use the app's own default
env.noValues: Only variable names are read from the repository. Values are never imported.

review.summary: This creates {{name}} from a {{framework}} repository with {{databases}} database(s), served at {{domain}}, and starts its first build.
review.failedResume: The app record exists. Press Deploy to continue where it stopped.

deployLink.title: Prefilled from a link. Review before deploying
deployLink.fromSource: A link from {{host}} filled in this form. Nothing is created until you press Deploy.
deployLink.fromUnknown: A link filled in this form. Nothing is created until you press Deploy.
deployLink.name: Name
deployLink.portHint: The port the app listens on inside its container.
deployLink.healthHint: Leave empty to skip the health check.
deployLink.envHint: The link names these variables. Enter your own values. They are stored as secrets.
deployLink.missingImage: The link did not include a valid image. Choose where this app comes from below.

errors.name: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
errors.image: Enter an image such as ghcr.io/you/app:latest.
errors.health: The path must start with a single slash.

no_lockfile.text: No lockfile was found, so installs are not reproducible.
no_lockfile.fix: Commit your lockfile and analyze again.

multiple_dockerfiles.fix: Pick the right one under Advanced if the choice is wrong.

malformed_manifest.text: A manifest could not be parsed, so this is a best guess.
malformed_manifest.fix: Fix the JSON or TOML syntax and analyze again.

dockerfile_no_expose.text: The Dockerfile has no EXPOSE line.
dockerfile_no_expose.fix: Add EXPOSE with your port, or set the port below.

monorepo_no_root_app.text: This is a monorepo with no app at its root.
monorepo_no_root_app.fix: Create one app per package below.

railpack_unsupported.text: Automatic builds don't cover this language yet.
railpack_unsupported.fix: Add a Dockerfile to the repository and analyze again.

starter.title: Starter templates
starter.description: Pick a starting point, answer a few questions and get validated files to commit to your repository.
starter.next: Commit these files to your repository, then deploy it from the Where is it from step.
starter.openHint: Generate app.yaml to commit to your repo.

packages.title: Workspace packages
packages.hint: This repository holds several packages. Create one app per package. Each builds from its own directory and redeploys only when it changes.
packages.creating: Creating the app and starting its first build...
packages.createSelected_one: Create an app for the selected package
packages.createSelected_other: Create an app for each selected package ({{count}})
packages.createSelected_zero: Create an app for each selected package
packages.envNote: Required environment variables are not asked for here. Add them on each app, then redeploy.

plan.title: Import plan
plan.hint: See the app each package would become before you create anything: name, port, build kind and what to double-check.
plan.loading: Reading every package in the repository...
plan.empty: No workspace packages were found, so there is nothing to plan. Configure this repository as a single app below.
plan.summary_one: {{count}} package, {{flagged}} with warnings. Nothing is created until you confirm.
plan.summary_other: {{count}} packages, {{flagged}} with warnings. Nothing is created until you confirm.

warnings.package_cap: {{found}} packages found, only the first {{cap}} are listed. Raise APP_WIZARD_MAX_PACKAGES on the server to see more.
warnings.tree_truncated: The repository file listing was cut short, so some packages may be missing.
warnings.no_dockerfile: No Dockerfile here. The build is auto-detected.
warnings.no_port: No listening port detected. Set it before creating.
warnings.duplicate_port: Another package proposes the same port. That is fine in separate containers.
warnings.duplicate_name: Another package maps to the same name, so a suffix was added.
warnings.name_taken: An app with this name already exists, so a suffix was added.
warnings.detect_failed: This package could not be analyzed.

editor.deploy: Start the first build of each app
editor.envHint: Values are sent once to create the app. Tick Secret to store a value encrypted. It is never shown again.
editor.reviewHint: Nothing is created yet. The check lists every problem first.
editor.dryRunSummary: {{create}} apps can be created. {{problems}} have problems and will be skipped. Nothing has been created.

confirm.description: This creates more than {{above}} apps at once. Review the list, then confirm.

fields.name: Name
fields.imageHint: The image to run, including a tag. No image yet? Pick the git option in step 1 and we'll build one.
fields.portHint: The port your app listens on inside its container, e.g. 3000 for a typical Next.js app.
fields.healthHint: Checked before traffic moves to a new container, and to spot a crashed one afterward. Change it or turn it off if your app doesn't serve this path.
fields.strategyHint: How new versions roll out. Blue-green starts the new version next to the old one and switches traffic once it's healthy.
fields.replicasHint: How many copies of your app run at once. Leave blank for one.

upload.title: Deploy from your computer
upload.description: No git remote needed. The folder is uploaded, built and deployed.
upload.note: Run both in your project folder. Files in .gitignore, node_modules and .env files are never uploaded.
upload.tokenHint: Valid for {{days}} days. Can read, edit and deploy apps.
upload.tokenOnce: Copy these now. The token is shown once and is valid for {{days}} days.

drop.cardDescription: Drop a folder or a .zip of a built site to replace what is live. _redirects, _headers and 404.html are honored, and you can roll back from deploy history.
drop.zoneLabel: Drop a site folder or zip here
drop.hint: A folder holding index.html, or a zip of it. A single wrapper folder inside the zip is unwrapped for you.
drop.empty: Nothing to publish in that drop. It was empty or held only ignored files such as .git and node_modules. Drop the folder that holds your built site.
drop.noIndex: This folder has no index.html at the top, so the site root will show a 404. Pick the folder that holds index.html if that is not what you want.
drop.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. Taken from the folder or file name. Change it if you like.
drop.done: Published. Watch the deploy for the live URL.
drop.doneNoIndex: Published, but the zip has no index.html at its top level, so the site root shows a 404.

errors.tooLarge: This site is over the upload limits. Remove large files you don't need, or ask an admin to raise the limits.
errors.nameTaken: A site or app with that name already exists. Change the name above and try again.
errors.network: The upload was interrupted. Check your connection and try again.
errors.tooManyFiles: That folder has too many files for one drop. Zip a smaller build output folder instead.

previews.unsupported: Previews need a GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket or Gitea repository.

health.label: Health check path
health.hint: A new version must answer 200 here before it receives traffic. Leave empty to use the detected path.

jobs.title: Add a background worker or scheduled job
jobs.hint: Scheduled jobs call a path on your app on a schedule, as HTTP requests. There is no separate worker process type, so run a long-lived worker as its own app.
